fieldValues.title: Many problems exist as two records with the same SP id
fieldValues.summary: At least SP-03, SP-12, SP-31, SP-36, SP-50, SP-59, SP-62, SP-63, SP-70, SP-79 and SP-97 each have two problem records with the same problem_id and title. Links split between them (for SP-97, 7 relations on ae1cd3f3 and 4 on 0d6f5bc2), so a reader that picks the wrong one sees less.
fieldValues.body: Found while linking findings on 2026-10-27: srs find --type com.semanticops.method/problem returns 216 hits for about 120 SP ids. The pair members differ only in instanceId and in which relations point at them. This needs a de-duplication through supersedes, not deletion.
